title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Waswassa, Talaq 9829 views Q. Can one communicate thru sms or mobile with her divorced wife 5672 views Q. Ruling about talaqs 4103 views Q. I want to know that if my wife has no fault and my parents ask me to divorce my wife then what should I do? 2223 views Q. My brother is going through bad marriage since last 16 years and he wants to divorce his wife they don't have any relationship and don't even live in the same bedroom my brother sleeps in hall and bhabhi in bedroom with children 2282 views Q. Iddah 4601 views Q. what is khula? how is it done? once it is done can the husband and wife get back ? 9452 views Q. My question is now that in Bangladesh, it's a bit common saying by wife to her husband that for example "are Bhai", (oh, brother) 2755 views Q. A man was requesting to wife as he was outstation and had been shivering with high fever and malaria his query was to inform his wife over phone that he wants to come back to home due to illness but his wife could not listen attentively by heart and said that no need to come die there. On listening this sentence her husband couldn?t control himself and said Talaq Talaq..Talaq and many times even he told to give phone to your mother and repeated the same many times. But, just after that one of brides family member and guardian asked the groom that did really and intentionally said this words, he replies while weeping out and very brokenly that no his intention was not to give Talaq but punishment to her to change her attitude. Sir, please advise whether this is Talaq or not :- 1. As, he was over phone and from both the sides there was no evidences except her mother and at the place of husband there was no body in evidences. 2. That time her wife was in pregnancy period. 3. That, several times husband tried to meet her but wife never come to meet him. 4. That, they never allowed him to meet with baby girl at the time of birth and after onwards. 5. That, still husband tried a lot to convince them even from local people but worthless. But, now they want to unite in light of holy Quran and Hadith and peace be upon him. Refer to above question, please give us Fatwa accordingly, we would be highly obliged of you. 1800 views Q. Assalamwalaikum, I want to ask you if after nikah a girl runs away with another man who is also married than does talaq happen?what if the girl wants talaq and the boy does not want to give talaq can she get talaq by herself?what will happen if the boy does not give talaq and they stay apart for a year will talaq happen then if the girl wants? 1889 views Q. Wife did not get any support (moral or relational) neither from her husband nor from husband's family members. Wife is now pregnant (7 months) and is at her mothers home. Husband did not visit her any time during pregnancy. Wife has developed hatredness against her husband and his family members. Now she wants to take divorce (khula). What does shariyat Say? 1634 views Q. My sister got emotionally & mentally abused by her husband and Inlaws.Her husband is unemployed and not support her.He is not even listen when we try to resolve the problems with our elders.And refuse to give Talaq.Hence we went to our city QAZI(in Aligarh,UP),who after listen her complain issue her KHULA(talaq) in written which is also attested by city Mufti and Notary too.But we didn't inform about this to her husband.What if he will challange this verdict in civil court .Will it be valid in civil law and will court approve it?We checked with All India Muslim Personal LAW Board also,they said it is valid. Pl suggest us something which will give peace to us as we don't want to go Civil court. 2486 views Q. Talaq pronounced to wife over phone without witness & without knowledge of her hayees who left house without my permission 9 months ago for no reason 6038 views Q. Talaq 1876 views Q. Due to bad behavior with me and my 2 sons I verbally pronounced Talak thrice to my wife. She refused to acknowledge the Talak saying that there was no witness to the Talak. Thereafter I pronounced Talak in the presence of a Mufti and 2 adult muslim witnesses. The written talaknama was sent to my wife by speed post which she has refused to accept. Technically she claims to have not been divorced and her family members support her. I left my house immediately after this incident and have been living in a separate house with my 2 sons for the last 2 and half years. As per the Muslim law and the Sharia, is my Talak valid. If it is please issue me Fatwa which I can produce in court so that my Talak can be recognized. 2271 views
answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 14318 Country: India Title: Assalamu alaikum, Dear Janab Mufti Sahib, I have left my wife on 31st May 2008 to her parent?s house when I came to know from doctor that she was conceived to take rest for two months. After that I called her for which her mother intervened and refused to send her. Because of her mother?s attitude towards me I stopped going to my in laws home. There was no contact between myself and my spouse from July 08 to September 08. During November 2008 my spouse called me over phone and asked for my blood group and I informed her the same. After that there were contacts over phone between me and my spouse till the date of delivery. After delivery I went to see my spouse and new born baby in Hospital. At hospital, her mother again intervened between us and there were heated arguments between me and her mother. After three months of delivery, I sent a letter to my spouse thro? post to come back to my home for which my spouse replied me thro? post ? that she thought of coming back after three months but your letter reached me prior to one day of three months time. (For your information the letter was written in Tamil though I know that my spouse cant write or read tamil) ?. Saying this she made a full stop without informing that whether she wants to come or not. Then I called her relatives (in Bangalore) to come and solve our problem. During the talks, there were heated arguments between my parents and her parents and the talks were failed. Then last Sunday, I called my spouse over phone then suggested her to come to a third parties place where we can sit and solve our differences for which she initially accepted and told me that after her father has gone for Jamaat and he will be returning tonight. Once her comes she will get permission and come on Monday. On Monday morning I called her over phone, she replied after asking her parents bit by bit over phone that I have to come to her parents? house to have any discussion on this, and she refused to come with me. Finally she told me that her relatives who are in Bangalore have to come and we will have an agreement on this after which she will be coming back to my house. In a fit of anger, I sent an SMS with these words ? Aaj ke din main tera aur mera rishta ku qatam karta hoon ye teen lafz se ? Talaq Talaq Talaq ?. Please convey me whether this talaq is valid, in my case I never had any quarrel with my wife nor wife has any dispute over me. The only dispute was with my self and her parents. Please let me know at your earliest. (Fatwa: 1099/L=207/TL/0) If, with the intention of giving talaq, you send SMS writing talaq, talaq, talaq thrice, your wife will get divorced with the three mughallazah (irrevocable) talaqs and she became haram for you. Now, you can not rejoin without a valid halalah . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
